thread:
Alex Chen: Heads-up — customer ACME in a VPC reported a step increase in tail token latency after we rolled the new kernel-selection heuristic yesterday. Observed ~4-6ms extra per-token on long-context routes. Anyone seen this in private deployments?
Priya Patel: seeing similar on my local replay with the 'auto-kernel' flag enabled. Profiling trace shows increased kernel switch churn around sequence lengths ~1024.
Samira Gómez: can you paste the flamegraph?
Alex Chen: pasted minimal flame in thread: ```
# short excerpt from perf
cpu_cycles -> kernel_selector.cpp:line 238
  choose_kernel() -> quant_kernels::matmul::fast_path
  fallback -> generic_matmul
kv_cache_lookup -> cache_manager.cpp:line 89 (miss spike)
batch_coalescer -> coalesce.cpp:line 112 (increased flushes)
```
Rajiv Kumar: probable causes: (1) kernel boundary conditions changed so small batch sizes trigger kernel swaps, (2) KV cache eviction policy churn for long-running sessions. Both can add latencies per token.
Lina Ortega: from metrics side we need token-level breakdowns exposed in private deployments so customers can root-cause. Current Prometheus export only sends per-request percentiles and aggregate p99. Not enough.
Tom (sre-bot): deploybot: new build 2026.03.12 baked to staging.
Alex Chen: suggested metrics to add in VPC exporter: `inference_token_latency_seconds{phase="decode|embed|kv_lookup|kernel_exec"}`, `kv_cache_hit_ratio`, `kernel_switches_total`, `batch_flushes_total`, and `route_label` for per-route KPIs.
Priya Patel: +1. Also expose `batch_size_histogram` and `kv_eviction_reason` string label (or code). For air-gapped customers we should support file-based export of the last N minutes of samples in OpenMetrics text format.
Samira Gómez: quick patch in my PR adds `kernel_switches_total` and increments on each swap. But I saw a 2-3x increase after the heuristic change; needs guard.
Rajiv Kumar: for private/VPC we have two integration patterns: 1) customer Prometheus scrapes our prometheus-exporter inside their VPC (service discovery + ServiceMonitor), 2) air-gapped -> we write periodic OpenMetrics files and provide an ops tool to sftp/rsync to their monitoring bastion. Both are already supported but need doc + new metrics.
Lina Ortega: proposal for dashboards: a per-route panel showing token-level latency waterfall (bars for kv_lookup, kernel_exec, decode), plus a heatmap of kernel_switches by sequence length and a timeseries for kv_cache_hit_ratio. Annotate when kernel-selection heuristics flip.
Alex Chen: can we get a quick example ServiceMonitor snippet? We should standardize labels so customers can plug into Grafana with minimal templating.
Priya Patel: example we use in Dedicated: ```yaml
apiVersion: monitoring.coreos.com/v1
kind: ServiceMonitor
metadata:
  name: redwood-inference-metrics
  labels:
    team: inference
spec:
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: redwood-exporter
  namespaceSelector:
    matchNames:
      - redwood-system
  endpoints:
    - port: metrics
      path: /metrics
      interval: 15s
      honorLabels: true
      metricRelabelings:
        - sourceLabels: [__name__]
          regex: inference_token_latency_seconds
          action: keep
```
Samira Gómez: for air-gapped customers I prototyped this helper which dumps last 10m of samples: ```bash
#!/bin/bash
curl -s http://localhost:9100/metrics | grep -E 'inference_|kernel_' > /tmp/inference_metrics_$(date +%s).prom
# scp to customer bastion
scp /tmp/*.prom bastion:/var/metrics/ingest/
```
Rajiv Kumar: for the kernel-selection regression we should add a canary metric `kernel_selection_version{strategy="auto|legacy|forceX"}` and wire it to rollout flags so we can correlate.
Lina Ortega: I'll add the token-level enumerated phases to the exporter. Also creating a Grafana template with variables: cluster, route, kernel_version, seq_len_bucket. It will include: - token waterfall - kernel switch heatmap - per-route p50/p95/p99 token cost - kv cache hit ratio by route.
Alex Chen: good. For next steps: Samira to add kernel-switch metric + guard, Lina to update exporter and Grafana dashboard, Priya to add ServiceMonitor docs for private installs, Rajiv to run replay against release candidate and validate.
Samira Gómez: will push PR by EOD with benchmark against 200 concurrent sessions.
Priya Patel: I'll draft docs and include the air-gap example + recommended scrape interval (15s) and retention guidance.
Rajiv Kumar: running the replay now. Initial run shows kernel-switch events correlate with spikes when batch sizes oscillate under 8 -> we should increase min-batch threshold to reduce churn.
Alex Chen: action: adjust batching heuristics to prefer keeping kernel stable over micro-optimizing single-token latency. Prioritize avoiding switches for same seq_len_bin unless batch_size delta > 16.
Tom (sre-bot): alert: perf-regression-monitor detected token_latency_seconds p99 increase on canary yesterday at 2026-03-12T18:22Z.
Lina Ortega: noted. I'll add an alert rule that fires when `increase(kernel_switches_total[5m]) > 10` and p99 token latency increases by >5% simultaneously.
Samira Gómez: one more note — KV cache behavior: we currently mark cached entries with last_used timestamp; eviction is LRU but we didn't account for long-lived chat sessions that pin large contexts. Suggest adding `kv_cache_ttl_by_route` config knob.
Alex Chen: good call. Let's regroup after Rajiv's full replay results. Thanks all :thumbsup:
Priya Patel: marking follow-ups in the eng-runtime board. I'll tag ACME support so they get the ServiceMonitor snippet and air-gap instructions. :eyes:
